replyToMessageId.description: The id of the message this one replies to, if any.

replyTo.description: A lightweight preview of the same-conversation message being replied to.

content.description: Always null when the replied-to message is encrypted.

encryption.description: none or v1; clients resolve an encrypted quote locally.

allOf.description: Envelope of an end-to-end encrypted message. The server validates its shape and key versions, never the ciphertext.
allOf.title: E2eMessagePayloadV1

400.description: Invalid request (bad query parameters, unsupported provider, etc.)

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked credential

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).

404.description:
The conversation is not accessible, or `replyToMessageId` does not
reference a message in this conversation.

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).
